# TriState

`Flare.Components.Combobox.TriState`

Tri-state of a "select all" affordance over the currently visible, enabled options.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | None of the visible enabled options are selected. |
| `Some` | `1` | Some but not all are selected (renders as the mixed / indeterminate state). |
| `All` | `2` | All visible enabled options are selected. |
